name: Torrijo del Campo (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white hoist third bearing a green lozenge charged with a yellow tower, and two small shields of the bars of Aragon at the fly.
history: Under mayor Miguel Ángel Meléndez the town council of Torrijo del Campo began a file for the adoption of municipal arms and a flag, which ended with the authorisation of the Government of Aragon by decree 100/1997 of 10 June to adopt them. The flag was to be a blue cloth of proportion 2/3, with a small shield of the Royal Sign of Aragon in each of its fly corners, and at the hoist a horizontal stripe of a third of the length of the cloth with a yellow tower with green door and windows placed within a white lozenge.

features.role: lozenge on the white hoist third
tower with green door and windows on the lozenge
